crossRefs.note: Israel struck him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, even to the children…
But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him; for Yahweh your God hardened his spirit and made his heart…
Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan. Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to…
and the border of Og king of Bashan, of the remnant of the Rephaim, who lived at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,
after he had struck Sihon the king of the Amorites who lived in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan who lived in…
To the sons of Gershom were given, out of the family of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with its pasture…

translations.web: and all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, to Sihon king of Heshbon and to Og king of Bashan, who was at Ashtaroth.
translations.bsb: and all that He did to the two kings of the Amorites beyond the Jordan—Sihon king of Heshbon and Og king of Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth.
translations.kjv: And all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites, that were beyond Jordan, to Sihon king of Heshbon, and to Og king of Bashan, which was at Ashtaroth.
